build_ResNet18_classifier: build a ResNet18 classifier model with a specified number of classes and feature filters
create_MLP_network: create a multi-layer perceptron network with Xavier weight initialization from a list of layer sizes
build_BasicBlock_residual: build a BasicBlock residual unit with convolutional layers and batch normalization for ResNet
create_conv3x3_layer: create a 3x3 convolutional layer with specified input and output planes and stride
apply_Xavier_initialization: apply Xavier uniform weight initialization to Linear layers in a PyTorch neural network module
